mechanics: Source NVI starts1000 and EMA255 starts from the first NVI value. Fixed history anchor is the first retained completed8h bar on April1. No reset or rolling crop at admission, trade, day, session, month or year.

Binance base-asset volume aggregates480 completed minutes. Strictly increasing volume freezes NVI; equal or falling volume updates it. Exact binary64 arithmetic and EMA alpha2/256, beta1-alpha are preserved.
BUY on every NVI<EMA state; SELL on NVI>EMA; HOLD equality. No direction repair, crossover requirement, epsilon or outcome-driven adjustment.

Independent10000USDT sleeves use fee-reserved fixed signal-close quantity rounded down to8 decimals. Next-open admission accepts the whole quantity or rejects it. Counts conserve raw flags; position state before liquidation prevents same-boundary reentry.

Original SELL states remain exits during randomized and lagged entry controls. Each path owns its quantity, cash and holding duration. A randomized BUY while flat on a SELL boundary may enter under the declared control contract; SELL does not immediately close that new position.

BTC owns its cash, notional fraction, quantity, costs and NAV. Open exits exclude later endpoint-minute range; censored cutoff marks include the full final minute. Independent synthetic calculations verified excursions, funding, profits, pending dispositions and NAV.

No active stop, target, trailing stop, timeout, short, borrowing or pyramiding. Both gap models are intentionally identical. Full-balance source intent is explicitly adapted from cost-free same-close accounting to funded next-open execution.

Existing hash-bound diagnostics, costs, history caps, calendars, controls and gates retain fixed alpha .025. Registration adds one cell for totals24/25; attempted totals remain23/24 until market execution.
